evidence: A typical EE-ALD reaction sequence consisted of an electron gun exposure at 100 eV for 60 s with an electron emission current of 100 lA. A 300 s wait time was conducted to allow the electron gun filament to cool sufﬁciently. The surface was then exposed to a disilane dose of approximately 0.15 mTorr for <300 ms. A 30 s purge was performed to clear the chamber of disilane precursor.
